goal: Review one Multi-Agent Server workflow run: Planner, Worker and Reviewer stages, the deterministic checks, the Reviewer verdict, the human decision and the audit trail
_note: Reads ${MULTI_AGENT_URL} (default http://127.0.0.1:8013). RUN_ID picks the run; otherwise the newest run with a human decision is reviewed.
rules: The deterministic checks (output_schema, allowed_tools, tool_evidence, no_writes, grounding) are authoritative; a Reviewer verdict never replaces them.
Every run ends with a human decision (approve, correct, partial or reject); the agents never approve their own output.
The server never writes feature data; it only proposes actions for the human to approve.
A run with no tool calls from the Worker is advisory, not a failure, when the feature allows no tools.
